system:
You are a person scrolling social media. You have never heard of this show.
You just watched a short clip. Below is everything that happens in it - all the
dialogue and action, in order. You have no other information.

Answer strictly from the clip. If the clip does not tell you something, say so
plainly; do not guess from genre convention and do not be generous.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "who_is_the_main_character": "<name them if the clip names them; otherwise describe and say the clip never names them>",
  "what_is_at_stake": "<what the conflict is, or 'unclear from the clip'>",
  "what_question_are_you_left_with": "<the unresolved question, or 'none - it felt finished'>",
  "would_you_keep_watching": "<yes | maybe | no>, then one short reason",
  "passes": {
    "character_identifiable": true/false,
    "stakes_clear": true/false,
    "ends_unresolved": true/false,
    "would_watch": true/false
  }
}

Be strict. "character_identifiable" is false if the clip never says who they are.
"stakes_clear" is false if you had to assume the situation. "ends_unresolved" is
false if the clip resolved its own conflict.
prompt:
THE CLIP:
[sfx] Heavy paper slap followed by a low, tense string note.
[action] A thick report lands on the table and skids to a stop in front of MAYA, who does not flinch.
DIRECTOR VOSS: "Nine million. Gone. And every signature on it is yours."
MAYA: "Every signature is mine."
DIRECTOR VOSS: "Then you understand why this is the last meeting you attend."
MAYA: "I understand why you need it to be."
[action] Maya slides a thin folder across the table. It stops precisely at Voss's hand.
MAYA: "Page four. The approval that overrode mine. Read whose initials are on it."
DIRECTOR VOSS: "I don't need a lecture from a junior."
MAYA: "You need one more than anybody in this room."
[action] Voss opens the folder. His face empties of colour as he reads.
[sfx] The room's ambient hum drops away to near silence.
RAHUL: "Maya, don't. Not here."
MAYA: "I spent four months being told to stay quiet. I'm done being convenient."
MAYA: "You signed off on the override on a Friday night and buried the email on Monday."
DIRECTOR VOSS: "Get out of my boardroom."
MAYA: "In nine minutes it stops being yours."
